Requirement Statement: The firmware shall register each physical USER button actuation as exactly one press event despite switch contact transitions.
Source Text / Evidence: Each press shall toggle an application state
Inference Rationale: Without distinguishing one physical actuation from its electrical contact transitions, a single press can be registered multiple times and toggle the application state more than once.
Acceptance Criteria: Each physical USER button actuation produces exactly one press event and one application-state toggle.
Preconditions: The firmware is running and the USER button is available.
Postconditions / Expected Behavior: The application state has toggled once for the physical actuation.
